description_expanded:
Oh Happy Day | WaterSound, FL

97 Coopersmith Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Welcome to "Oh Happy Day", located at 97 Coopersmith Lane. This stunning multi-level vacation home sleeps 12, featuring 5 bedrooms plus a bunk room with 4 twin beds and 1 full bed, along with 5 full bathrooms and 2 half bathrooms. Enjoy the perfect mix of comfort and style with a private pool, golf cart*, outdoor shower, and gas grill - all while being just minutes from the beach.

On the first floor, you'll find an open-concept living and dining area that flows seamlessly into a fully equipped gourmet kitchen - perfect for gathering over home-cooked meals or morning coffee. This level also includes a laundry room, two half bathrooms, and a serene guest bedroom with a king-size bed and private ensuite bathroom.

Ascending to the second floor, you'll find the master bedroom featuring a king-size bed, private balcony, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom complete with a soaking tub and a spacious shower with dual shower heads. Following the master suite are two additional guest bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, a private balcony, and a private ensuite bathroom. This floor also includes a laundry room, a dedicated office space, and a cozy sitting area with a TV - perfect for relaxing or catching up on work between beach days.

The third floor is a versatile retreat designed for both comfort and convenience. A spacious bunk room with four twin beds and an additional full bed in the hallway provides ample sleeping space for children or extra guests, while a full bathroom with a shower and tub combination adds ease. The media room offers a cozy space to relax and enjoy movie nights, and a nearby sink with a mini fridge ensures refreshments are always within reach - combining thoughtful design with effortless coastal living.

Step outside to your private oasis, featuring a private pool, gas grill, and ample seating for alfresco dining. After a sun-filled afternoon, rinse off in the outdoor shower, take a ride on one of the five provided beach cruiser bikes, or simply unwind and soak up the coastal breeze.

This home offers the ideal blend of luxury and laid-back beach living - everything you need for your next 30A getaway.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
